reviews.t: Glue dried up when I received it!
reviews.x: This eyelash extension glue did not burn my eyes I could do my own and didn’t have to always use a fan very gentle and adherence was great but I reordered this glue and it came completely dried out in the bottle!

claims.text: Many reviewers report eye irritation, burning, swelling, or allergic reactions, with some saying the formula seems to have changed.
Several reviewers say the glue does not stick well or lashes fall off quickly, including complaints that a reformulated version performs worse than before.
Some reviewers praise the glue as great for DIY beginners, holding well and drying without irritation for them.
A few reviewers note slow drying time, which some find good for beginners but others find hard to work with.
One reviewer reports the glue is not waterproof and lashes fall off when wet, and another received a dried-out product.
